CINEMA.VazioTexto: No cutscenes yet. Click Add and pick a video.
CINEMA.ExibirAgora: Play now (downloads for whoever is missing it and starts on its own)
CINEMA.PreCarregarAoEntrar: Download automatically when a player joins the world
CINEMA.ConfirmarRemover: Remove "{nome}" from the library and from every player's disk?
CINEMA.CacheHint: Players who already have this video saved to disk
CINEMA.PesoHint: 4K video: four times the weight of 1080p to download and decode on every player.
CINEMA.DicaHotbar: Drag a card onto the hotbar to have the scene one click away.
CINEMA.SomBloqueadoHint: This player's browser hasn't received a click yet: the scene plays muted until they click.
CINEMA.Avisos.SoMestre: Only the GM can play cutscenes.
CINEMA.Avisos.NaoEncontrada: That cutscene is no longer in the library.

CINEMA.Config.SilenciarMusicaHint: Lowers playing playlists while the scene runs and restores their volume afterwards.
CINEMA.Config.FecharNoFimHint: Returns to the table automatically when the video ends.
CINEMA.PedirTelaCheia: Fullscreen when the player clicks the scene
